questions.text: When does React call the function passed to useState?
questions.answer: Once, when the instance mounts. Its result becomes the initial state.

questions.text: What happens if a component receives children but does not return them?
questions.answer: The nested element does not mount. Its function is not called.

questions.text: In what order does React call sibling component functions?
questions.answer: Left to right, in the order the children appear in the parent.

questions.text: Does the setter change the useState const in the current call?
questions.answer: No. The new value is visible only on the next render.

questions.text: Does key land in the child props?
questions.answer: No. React keeps key for itself. It is not in props.

questions.text: Why do you pass the function itself to onClick, rather than calling it?
questions.answer: A call with parentheses runs during render. onClick needs the function React will call on the event.
